0.name: TEXT_REGOTH3THERUBYPRICE_00406_TSURUGI_000_000
0.description: An ijin traveler? What are you doing here? If you are looking to cross into Kugane, you need go further east.

5.name: TEXT_REGOTH3THERUBYPRICE_00406_TSURUGI_000_010
5.description: I am one of the many bakufu soldiers stationed here, charged with patrolling the waters surrounding Hingashi.

6.name: TEXT_REGOTH3THERUBYPRICE_00406_TSURUGI_000_011
6.description: I hail from Koshu─the largest of the many islands that make up our great nation.

7.name: TEXT_REGOTH3THERUBYPRICE_00406_TSURUGI_000_012
7.description: For the next three years I will be serving at this post and shall do whatever is required of me to fulfill my duty here.

8.name: TEXT_REGOTH3THERUBYPRICE_00406_TSURUGI_000_020
8.description: This is the Ruby Price─a Hingan bastion erected by the bakufu in the middle of the Ruby Sea.

9.name: TEXT_REGOTH3THERUBYPRICE_00406_TSURUGI_000_021
9.description: Whenever an enemy ship draws too near, we fire upon them until nothing but burning planks remain.

10.name: TEXT_REGOTH3THERUBYPRICE_00406_TSURUGI_000_022
10.description: We must take extra precautions when doing so, however, as we are stationed very close to the trading port of Kugane. We do not want to mistakenly open fire on a commercial or otherwise friendly vessel.

11.name: TEXT_REGOTH3THERUBYPRICE_00406_TSURUGI_000_023
11.description: Such an error would be akin to waging war upon what may have been an allied or neutral nation.
